notes: OUTCOME: upgradeTower(state, id) in src/game.js meets the brief. It raises the level, adds the per-level damage and range that the kind declares in src/tower.js (LANTERN 25 gold, +1 damage, +20 range), and takes the upgrade cost from the player's gold. It refuses with 'gold' or 'max' and changes nothing when it does. 'max' is checked before 'gold', and MAX_LEVEL is 3. test/upgrade.test.js asserts each case, including that level, damage, range and gold are unchanged after a refusal.

OUTCOME: the remaining requirements are met. Towers now get a unique id from state.nextTowerId. A left click on a tower's cell selects it through clickCell instead of being refused as 'taken'. selectedModel gives the HUD the selected tower's level, damage, range and upgrade cost (null at the maximum), and render.js draws these on a tower card. drawLevelMarks draws one mark per level on an upgraded tower: none at level 1, 2 at level 2, 3 at level 3. This matches the issue's wording, 'an upgraded tower is drawn with a mark per level', and is tested both directly and through draw().

CONSTRUCTION: no defect found. A refused upgrade returns before anything is changed. Each tower keeps its own copy of the upgrade data, so a structuredClone of the game still upgrades, and a test covers this. main.js clears the selection on restart and on Escape, ignores a held key's repeat for U, and only upgrades while the round is playing. A click on an empty cell still places a tower as before and clears the selection.
